info.title: ColdProof API • Cold Chain Evidence Platform
info.description:
APEX • GenD Arena 2026 • Technical Validation Specification v3.2.

Evidence workflow for pharma cold chain:
- Ingestion & adapters (Zenodo, Mendeley, Vendor-inspired formats)
- Canonical normalization with immutable provenance
- Batch-centric timeline & segment mapping (CP-DEMO-001)
- Exception engine (DEMO_2_8C product profile)
- QA human-in-the-loop review actions
- Evidence package reports with SHA-256 integrity hash
- Immutable audit trail
